dataRecordMapping.description:
Provides a mapping from a data record returned by an api call, which may be in any shape,
to the shape required by the concrete data spec setting type implementation.

fieldName.description: The name of the field to which these settings apply

fillColorSteps.description:
The number of steps used to bucket the gradient color values.
If not specified, the number of steps are calculated using the following equation:
{@link #fillColorGradientMax} - {@link #fillColorGradientMin} + 1.

fillColorGradientMin.description: The min value to map to the min gradient color.

fillColorGradientMax.description: The max value to map to the max gradient color.

fillColorGradientMinColor.description: The color associated with the min gradient value.

fillColorGradientMaxColor.description: The color associated with the max gradient value.

title:
Color the node, edge or GeoJSON region based on a specified field's value in the data. The color of the item will be
assigned by where its field value falls along a gradient set by the option values of this type. One of
{@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationFillColorByPropertyStrategyGradient#fillColorSteps} or
{@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationFillColorByPropertyStrategyGradient#fillColorGradientMin} and
{@link UiSdlGraphVisualizationFillColorByPropertyStrategyGradient#fillColorGradientMax} must be provided for the
component to accurately determine the color gradient scale.
name: UiSdlGraphVisualizationFillColorByPropertyStrategyGradient
